title: Character
description: A character belonging to a world. Captures personality (for consistent behaviour/voice), a locked visual 'appearance_token' (for consistent illustration), and an evolution track (so the character can grow across a series without losing identity).

one_liner.description: Who they are in a sentence.

personality.description: The behavioural fingerprint. Stories must keep the character acting from these — this is personality consistency.

flaws.description: The growth edges that drive arcs.

voice.description: How the character talks — for consistent dialogue.

appearance.description: Structured physical description — the source of the model sheet and the appearance_token.

height.description: Relative scale matters for consistency, e.g. 'knee-high to an adult'.

outfit.description: The default/signature outfit. Changes should be deliberate and logged in evolution.

distinguishing_features.description: The 2-4 unmistakable features that survive the 'silhouette test' (e.g. 'star-shaped patch over left eye','always carries a brass lantern').

color_palette.description: Locked per-part colors. Re-stated in every image prompt featuring this character.

silhouette_notes.description: What makes the character recognisable in pure silhouette.

appearance_token.description: THE consistency lever. A single dense descriptor string inserted verbatim into every image prompt featuring this character, e.g. 'PIP: a small round hedgehog girl, age 6, warm chestnut quills (#7a4a2b), big copper eyes (#c97b3a), red polka-dot raincoat (#c0392b), yellow rubber boots (#f1c40f), tiny acorn pendant, cheerful'. Keep it stable forever; only evolution stages may extend it.

reference_images.description: Relative paths to canonical reference renders (model sheet / turnaround / hero shot) reused as image-to-image anchors.

seed.description: Preferred image-generation seed for this character, reused to stabilise renders.

evolution.description: Ordered growth stages across the series. Each stage may adjust personality and appearance WITHOUT breaking core identity. Stories reference a stage id.

summary.description: Where the character is emotionally/in their arc at this stage.

personality_delta.description: What changed inside since the previous stage.

appearance_delta.description: Visible changes (taller, new scarf, older eyes). Appended to appearance_token when this stage is active.
